reason: Provides an AI-facing math and geometry tutoring capability by reading figures, extracting structured numerical data, and applying deterministic consistency checks before returning results.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向数学与几何题图的视觉插件，可提取向量、矩阵、坐标和角度等结构化数据，并进行维度与几何一致性校验。
summaries.en: A vision plugin for math and geometry figures that extracts structured data such as vectors, matrices, coordinates, and angles, then checks dimensional and geometric consistency.

capabilities: Processes user-provided images of mathematical, geometric, and statistical figures
Calls an OpenAI-compatible external vision model API
Extracts structured numerical and geometric data
Performs deterministic dimensional and geometric consistency checks
Exposes functionality through Python, CLI, MCP, opencode, and DeepSeek Harness integrations
Can render extracted results to PNG and generate TikZ output
